Name: Alternative Texture pack for Yri's Project Yellog Modular Trees
Author: OhMyMycroft
Description:
[font=Courier New]Hi! This is a pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] Framework, [color=#ff0000][u]you'll need it for this to work[/u]![/color]

This pack uses [color=#ffffff][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2893756]YriKururu[/url][/color] Modular Trees textures, that you can find under "[i]Optional Files[/i]" on the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799?tab=files]Yri's Project Yellog - Town Overhaul[/url] page, and let you have all the colours at once, [color=#dd7e6b]for[/color] [color=#9fc5e8]a[/color] [color=#d5a6bd]real[/color] [color=#93c47d]pastel[/color] [color=#ffe599]nonsense[/color].
The framework [size=3][b]only works on cuttable trees[/b][/size]: [color=#6aa84f][color=#ffffff]Pine[/color][/color], Oak, Maple, Mahogany and Palms, no bushes or world trees, unfortunately.[/font]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZONwQr5h.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]Download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿﻿[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]Unzip it in your mod folder[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]Download this mod[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]Unzip in your mod folder[/font]
[*][font=Courier New][b]Done![/b][/font]

[/list]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/kKYNxVoh.png[/img]
[list=1]
[*][font=Courier New]Delete it from your mod folder[/font]
[*][font=Courier New][b]That's it![/b][/font]
[/list]
[font=Courier New]There's little to no way this pack can cause conflict with anything, you can have as many Alternative Textures pack as you wish, and you can delete it without a care, all the trees customized will revert to their vanilla sprite (or whatever CP recolour you're currently using) without fuss.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/XHLqPFAh.png[/img]
Trees will pick one of the available textures at random, when they generate, [color=#999999](all the colours here have the same chance of appearing)[/color] so it's perfect on new saves. Or cut down everything that can be cut down and [color=#ea9999]let a new[color=#ffffff],[/color] [color=#a4c2f4]colourful[/color] [color=#b6d7a8]world grow from its ashes[/color][/color].

You can also change trees' texture at will using the [color=#f1c232][b][size=4]Paint Bucket[/size][/b][/color] sold by Robin, the carpenter.

Search the Alternative Textures in-game menu [color=#999999](you access it through the Paint Bucket)[/color] using the keys:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Courier New]Project Yellog[/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Courier New]Yellog[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]YriKururu[/font]
[*][font=Courier New]Yri[/font]
[/list][font=Courier New][color=#999999](this is useful if you have more AT packs adding trees' textures)
[/color][/font][font=Courier New]
Or the colour you would like to use:
[/font][list]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#6d9eeb]blue[/color][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#ea9999]cherry blossom, [/color][/font][font=Courier New]or [color=#e06666]cherry[/color], or [color=#ea9999]blossom[/color][/font]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#cc4125]fall[/color][/font]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#8e7cc3]lavender[/color][/font]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#38761D]dark green[/color][/font]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#6aa84f]light green[/color][/font]
[*][font=Courier New][color=#b6d7a8]pastel green[/color][/font][font=Courier New], or just [color=#76a5af]green[/color] for the three of them[/font]
[/list][font=Courier New]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/8mnYkNe.gif[/img]
﻿
You can also customize which texture recolour you want to appear in game using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]﻿, under Alternative Textures sub-menu. This can only be done from the title menu, though.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ltgog8f.gif[/img]

This is useful when you want to narrow the range of colours you want to appear in game, or if you want to give each season its own feel, a Summer in [color=#6aa84f]shades[/color] [color=#d9ead3]of[/color] [color=#93c47d]green[/color], an Autumn [color=#dbb0a7]that[/color] [color=#e06666]blushes[/color] or a [color=#cfe2f3]sugar[/color] [color=#b4a7d6]pastel[/color] [color=#f4cccc]dream[/color] Winter.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/DdhWrJD.gif[/img]

This was created to accompany [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9799?tab=files]Yri's Project Yellog - Town Overhaul[/url], and its Modular Trees and Bushes Recolor add-on, but [color=#ffd966][u]it doesn't need it[/u][/color], and can be used﻿ with whatever you want.
[color=#e06666]Who am I to tell you what to do?[/color]

So go and live your very own pastel fantasy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/rpXLmla.gif[/img]
[color=#ff0000]
DISCLAIMERS!![/color]
[color=#ff0000]The assets used here are not mine[/color], but [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/2893756]YriKururu[/url]'s, [u]if you want to use anything here, you need to ask permission first[/u].
I have permission from the original mod creator, you should ask too.
Thanks to [color=#e06666]YriKururu[/color] to let me publish this! [img]https://i.imgur.com/3GI1HVB.gif[/img]

If you have any problem with Alternative Textures you should go to the original mod page, I'm not the one that made it, sorry.

[font=Courier New][size=1]
